# B2-r5 P1 independent evaluation (generated by b2_independent.py from raw.json)

350 compress → verify → extract runs on the held-out test split, all byte-exact; every dataset/mode produced the same archive SHA256 in all repetitions.
Times are medians over repetitions of the in-tool compress / extract call (decision included); CPU = process user+kernel (≈15.6 ms resolution). Warm OS cache (each dataset read once before measuring).
